messages:
alex: heads up - saw a spike in fncall schema rejects on /compose route, looks tied to kv-prefix caching
maria: logs?
alex: pasted snippet:

```
WARN 2026-03-20T14:12:03Z adapter=kv-cache id=adp-78 fncall_parse_error: expected object, got string
TRACE req=6140001111 route=compose model=redwood-4k variant=bloom q=0.8 adapter_chain=[adp-78,adp-http]
```

devon: interesting, adapter_chain shows kv-cache first. We recently enabled prefix-compression for small msgs
maria: that explains it. the schema validator expects {tool:..., args:{}} but we end up with `"\"...` encoded as a string
jordan: is this causing routing fallback to degen? saw increased degen route counts
alex: yes, quota meter shows more hits on fallback tier and cost wedge
telemetry-bot: alert: fncall.schema_rejects rate increased 4.7x in the last 30m
maria: quick mitigation: brief rollout rollback of prefix-compression? or add post-adapter decode step
devon: can we include adapter_id in telemetry trace so console can show which adapter mutated payload
alex: +1. Also need a dashboard tile: 'fncall origin chain' with adapter ids and validator errors
jordan: UX: show first error message inline and a 'view raw chain' link
maria: i'll open a tiny PR to decode after kv-cache and add `adapter.decode_map` flag. also adding `adapter_id` to stats proto
alex: thanks. can we do a canary for 10% traffic first? don't want noisy rollback
devon: sure, rollout plan: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with automated reject monitoring in first 15m
alex: logging change (example):

```
INFO req=6140001111 adapter=kv-cache decode_status=decoded adapter_id=adp-78 post_payload={\"tool\":\"search\",\"args\":{}}
```

maria: created PR #4321 and a console ticket ENG-8002 for dashboard tile
jordan: adding myself to review. will update the release war room if needed
alex: thanks team :thumbsup:
